# FlowPoint

> FlowPoint is a digital-growth SaaS workspace connecting SEO analysis, local search, competitor insights, website monitoring, analytics, reporting, and AI-supported recommendations for businesses and their teams.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://flowpoint.pro/): Platform overview
- [Features](https://flowpoint.pro/features): Product capabilities and dashboard previews
- [Pricing](https://flowpoint.pro/pricing): Plans and pricing details
- [Benefits](https://flowpoint.pro/benefits): Product benefits
- [About](https://flowpoint.pro/about): Company information and mission
- [Contact](https://flowpoint.pro/contact): Contact form and support details
- [Updates](https://flowpoint.pro/updates): Product changes and improvements
- [Careers](https://flowpoint.pro/careers): Open positions

## Product pages

- [SEO audit](https://flowpoint.pro/seo-audit): Website analysis and prioritized search optimization opportunities
- [Local SEO](https://flowpoint.pro/local-seo): Local visibility and geographic search tracking
- [Website monitoring](https://flowpoint.pro/website-monitoring): Availability, performance and technical monitoring
- [SEO reporting](https://flowpoint.pro/seo-reporting): Clear reports for reviewing SEO performance and next steps
- [Competitor analysis](https://flowpoint.pro/competitor-analysis): Search competitor comparisons and opportunity discovery
- [Resources](https://flowpoint.pro/resources): Guides and practical digital-growth content
